# Agent Kickstart

> A guided, project-local first project for people new to Claude Code: it interviews you, proposes concrete starter projects, and begins one with you — no coding or terminal experience required.

Agent Kickstart is a small stateful onboarding harness for Claude Code, not a general-purpose
agent framework, a personality quiz, or a single sequential prompt. It is intentionally
Claude Code-specific: its project commands, permission settings, lifecycle hooks, native
selector, and optional history import all use Claude Code surfaces. Supporting Codex or another
agent would need a separate adapter and is not built or claimed in this release.

Maturity: `0.3.1`, alpha. Tested on macOS and Linux with the current Claude Code CLI; the shell
installer is exercised on macOS and Linux in CI, and the PowerShell installer is syntax- and
logic-checked but has not been run on Windows in this release.

## Docs

- [DEMO](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-kickstart/blob/main/DEMO.md): a ten-minute friend demo
- [DEVELOPMENT](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-kickstart/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md): architecture, project structure, and the test commands
